characters.identity: An older South Asian man, approximately 55 to 60, with medium warm brown skin, a broad slightly rounded face, short salt-and-pepper hair swept naturally to one side, a tidy close-cropped salt-and-pepper beard, and understated dark rectangular glasses. Average height with a softly stocky build. His expression is thoughtful and friendly, with subtle smile lines. Outfit: pale mint rolled-sleeve button-up shirt, dark aqua straight-leg trousers, a simple dark belt and light sneakers. One hand holds a slim white notebook against his waist while the other opens in a small explanatory gesture. Create a distinctive older face, not a young person with grey hair. Working reference name Arun; do not print the name in the image.

An East Asian woman, approximately 35 to 40, with a natural light-medium warm skin tone, a softly angular oval face, dark brown eyes and straight black chin-length bob hair tucked behind one ear. Average height and a sturdy athletic build. Her expression is attentive and quietly confident, with a small natural smile. Outfit: an aqua overshirt worn open over a crisp white top, blue straight-leg trousers, light sneakers, and tiny simple stud earrings. Relaxed standing pose, one hand loosely holding a slim white notebook at her side and the other making a small open conversational gesture. Give her individual, proportionate facial features without exaggerated ethnic markers. Working reference name Mei; do not print the name in the image.

A white man of European appearance, approximately 35 to 45, with a natural fair complexion, a few subtle freckles across the nose, short wavy chestnut-brown hair, dark eyebrows and a clean-shaven face. Tall with an average build and relaxed shoulders. His expression is warm and engaged, with a small confident smile. Outfit: a pale cool blue rolled-sleeve collared shirt, dark blue straight-leg trousers, a simple dark belt and light sneakers; a plain watch is the only accessory. He holds a slim white notebook comfortably in one hand, while the other makes a small open conversational gesture. Keep the fair skin naturally light without an orange cast. Working reference name Alex; do not print the name in the image.

A senior Caucasian / white woman, approximately 60 to 65, with fair naturally rosy skin, a mature face with subtle smile lines, a shoulder-length silver-grey bob with a side part, an upright relaxed stance and a comfortably fuller build. Softly tailored dark aqua blazer, white blouse, wide-leg blue trousers, light flat shoes, small gold stud earrings and a simple watch. Holds a plain white folio down by her side. Capable, warm and approachable.
